label: Text Case
author: conky-studio
description: Force text to UPPER, lower, or Title Case -- e.g. normalizing Now Playing status or a weather condition string before a Text Label.
lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = tostring({value})
 local mode = '{mode}'
 if mode == 'upper' then return v:upper() end
 if mode == 'lower' then return v:lower() end
 local out = {}
 for word in v:gmatch('%S+') do
 local first = word:sub(1,1):upper()
 local rest = word:sub(2):lower()
 table.insert(out, first .. rest)
 end
 return table.concat(out, ' ')
end)()
